selections.rationale: Strong platform signal with specific governance, grounding, deterministic routing, and human-escalation mechanisms; concise and distinct from the other bullets.
Connects enterprise adoption, CFO alignment, usage forecasting, and reusable commercialization without overstating a quantified outcome.
Clearly grounds production reliability in runtime observability, evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls while maintaining disciplined keyword use.
Presents a repeatable end-to-end solution lifecycle and client-deployment outcome, complementing rather than duplicating the runtime reliability bullet.
Uses direct language and concrete distributed-platform components across AWS, Databricks pipelines, vector services, and parallel workflows.
Preserves the protected 8-to-28 team-growth metric while pairing leadership scale with reusable platform commercialization and operating-model focus.
